propositions: Plan review and code review currently use independent registry, routing, runner, checkpoint, and failure paths, leading to inconsistent policy application and missed criteria enforcement.

A unified discovery architecture must compute an immutable effective-policy snapshot once and share a common typed executor for both gates while preserving their independent verdict policies and topologies.
Project code-review LLM criteria must enforce non-empty repository-relative glob lists, with migration of empty-list semantics to explicit `["**"]` repository-wide convention.
The `rebar review-plan --retry` command must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing calls with fresh budget, and refuse stale or ineligible lineages before any model call.
Discovery executor owns typed outcomes, budget enforcement, and success-only checkpoint mechanics; gate strategies retain context, topology, and verdict decisions.
Expand-contract migration must compute legacy and new deterministic projections from identical observed calls and allow only approved deltas without duplicate model calls.
